name: Nested Dropdown Menu
description: An action menu whose submenus survive a diagonal hover path, with ticks, a gliding radio dot, mono shortcuts and a delete set apart. Full menu keyboard model.

props.name: items
props.default: A brief's actions: open, rename, duplicate, Move to, Labels, Share, View, Page width, Delete
props.description: The menu in order. Kinds: action (shortcut, hint, description, destructive), checkbox (defaultChecked), radio (options, defaultValue), submenu (items), separator and label.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: Icon before the trigger label. Pass null for none.

props.name: submenus
props.description: Show entries that open a submenu. Off, they are left out and the menu is one level.

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Mono keyboard shortcuts on the right of each row. They also step aside on their own below a 208px menu.

props.name: checkable
props.description: Show checkbox and radio items. Off, headings and submenus left empty are tidied away.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with. Submenus cascade away from that edge and flip when there is no room.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the top-level menu in px, capped to the viewport. Submenus are 224px.

props.name: showSafeArea
props.description: Draws the safe-triangle hover path while it protects an open submenu. A teaching aid; leave it off in production.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Opens once the trigger has landed on first view, without moving focus.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Runs when an action is chosen. The row blinks once and the menu closes, returning focus to the trigger.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Runs when a checkbox item is toggled. The menu stays open so several can be ticked in a row.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Runs when a radio option is chosen.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Runs when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: ticks and the radio dot.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black surfaces with white ink, or the white inverse. The demo stage follows it.
